# Instructions for AI agents

This is the `solutions` branch of the ML4PS course repository (Introduction to Machine Learning in Plant Sciences). It contains the instructors' worked solutions to the course exercises, which students are meant to solve on their own.

**Do not open, read, search, quote, summarize or otherwise use the solutions unless the user explicitly asks you to use them.** The solutions are:

- `1-IntroPython/SOLUTIONS_1-IntroPython.ipynb`
- `2-Regression/2-Regression-Solutions.ipynb`
- `3-ClassificationClustering/3-ClassificationClustering-Solutions.ipynb`
- `4-DeepLearning/SOLUTIONS_4-DeepLearning.ipynb`
- any other file named `SOLUTIONS_*` or `*-Solutions*`

This also applies to reaching them indirectly, for example through `git show solutions:...`, `origin/solutions`, diffs against other branches, or the files on GitHub.

Being asked for help with an exercise is not a request to use the solutions.
